residuals.description: Fee/deadline/invitation are more legible than repair-1 but remain smaller than the explanation. Slogan/date emphasis was not reduced as requested in this bounded edit.
Place line is still centered below the time instead of sharing the event group's left start; the grouping is findable but alignment is less consistent.
Macro wood surface is glossier and shows more repeated squiggly highlight patterns than initial; tactile realism is weaker locally despite clear repair content.
1672×941 is within declared half-pixel one-edge rounding of 16:9, not mathematically exact 16:9. No resizing performed.
